parsed.why: No criminalisation, but tier-1 universal exposures operate: strip-search by birth sex, custody placement by birth sex, ward exclusion (documented death). Functioning institutions enforce the hostile rule; the in-force single-sex-spaces code was warned against by UN experts.

Enforced morality and advocacy statutes; presentation-based arrests and a 2023 cross-dressing conviction; police sexual coercion of a trans woman; no gender-marker route; documented impunity, prison care denial and refusals of HIV treatment.

No criminalisation and a 2018 equality guarantee; only LGBT-wide societal stigma documented; no trans-specific violence, police, facility or entry practice recorded. Thin record extrapolated from decriminalisation and absence of any documented traveller-facing exposure.

Identity not criminalised and courts granted document recognition, but only piecemeal; 2024-2026 document street harassment, physical and sexual assault of visibly trans people in provincial cities and official hate speech. Partial legal recourse.

Buggery and gross-indecency offences upheld by the High Court in 2024; no SOGI protection, no support infrastructure; documented bias-motivated violence and attacks on cross-dressing people. Enforcement frequency undocumented, but hostility and legal exposure real.
